2026-11-26.title: Marvel's The Defenders
2026-11-26.overview: Daredevil, Jessica Jones, Luke Cage and Iron Fist join forces to take on common enemies as a sinister conspiracy threatens New York City.

2026-11-26.title: WandaVision
2026-11-26.overview: Wanda Maximoff and Vision—two super-powered beings living idealized suburban lives—begin to suspect that everything is not as it seems.

2026-11-26.title: Marvel's Daredevil
2026-11-26.overview: Lawyer-by-day Matt Murdock uses his heightened senses from being blinded as a young boy to fight crime at night on the streets of Hell’s Kitchen as Daredevil.

2026-11-26.title: Stan Lee's Lucky Man
2026-11-26.overview: London cop and compulsive gambler Harry Clayton is on the verge of losing everything. On the night when his huge debts are to be called in, he meets the enigmatic Eve, who gives him a mysterious bracelet said to endow the wearer with immense luck. Harry's fortunes suddenly begin to shift, but he also soon finds himself sucked into a sinister crime wave sweeping through the city.

2026-11-26.title: Marvel Studios Legends
2026-11-26.overview: Revisit the epic heroes, villains and moments from across the MCU in preparation for the stories still to come. Each dynamic segment feeds directly into the upcoming series — setting the stage for future events. This series weaves together the many threads that constitute the unparalleled Marvel Cinematic Universe.

2026-11-26.title: Ironheart
2026-11-26.overview: After the events of Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, technology is pitted against magic when Riri Williams, a young, genius inventor determined to make her mark on the world, returns to her hometown of Chicago. Her unique take on building iron suits is brilliant, but in pursuit of her ambitions, she finds herself wrapped up with the mysterious yet charming Parker Robbins aka "The Hood."

2026-11-26.title: Agatha All Along
2026-11-26.overview: Agatha Harkness gathers a coven of witches and sets off down, down, down The Witches' Road.

2026-11-26.title: Marvel's Luke Cage
2026-11-26.overview: Given superstrength and durability by a sabotaged experiment, a wrongly accused man escapes prison to become a superhero for hire.

2026-11-26.title: The Gifted
2026-11-26.overview: A suburban couple's ordinary lives are rocked by the sudden discovery that their children possess mutant powers. Forced to go on the run from a hostile government, the family joins up with an underground network of mutants and must fight to survive.

2026-11-26.title: Marvel's The Punisher
2026-11-26.overview: A former Marine out to punish the criminals responsible for his family's murder finds himself ensnared in a military conspiracy.

2026-11-26.title: Hawkeye
2026-11-26.overview: Former Avenger Clint Barton has a seemingly simple mission: get back to his family for Christmas. Possible? Maybe with the help of Kate Bishop, a 22-year-old archer with dreams of becoming a superhero. The two are forced to work together when a presence from Barton’s past threatens to derail far more than the festive spirit.

2026-11-26.title: Daredevil: Born Again
2026-11-26.overview: Matt Murdock, a blind lawyer with heightened abilities, is fighting for justice through his bustling law firm, while former mob boss Wilson Fisk pursues his own political endeavors in New York. When their past identities begin to emerge, both men find themselves on an inevitable collision course.

2026-11-26.title: Wonder Man
2026-11-26.overview: Simon and Trevor, two actors at opposite ends of their careers, chase life-changing roles.

2026-11-26.title: Marvel's Cloak & Dagger
2026-11-26.overview: Two teenagers from very different backgrounds awaken to newly acquired superpowers which mysteriously link them to one another.

2026-11-26.title: Moon Knight
2026-11-26.overview: When Steven Grant, a mild-mannered gift-shop employee, becomes plagued with blackouts and memories of another life, he discovers he has dissociative identity disorder and shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector. As Steven/Marc’s enemies converge upon them, they must navigate their complex identities while thrust into a deadly mystery among the powerful gods of Egypt.

2026-11-26.overview: It's 1946, and peace has dealt Peggy Carter a serious blow as she finds herself marginalized when the men return home from fighting abroad.
